islam.title: What is Islam?
islam.summary: Islam is a religion of monotheism: belief in God, His messengers and books, the Last Day and divine decree, together with worship and righteous action.

pillars.title: Five pillars
items: Pilgrimage to the Sacred House for whoever is able

wudu.title: Purification and wudu
wudu.intro: Educational presentation; some legal details differ among the schools.

salat.title: Prayer
salat.intro: Daily worship with appointed times, essential elements, postures and recitations; some details have recognized legal differences.

faq.a: “Allah” is the Arabic proper name used in the Qur’an for God. A difference of language does not imply a different deity.
Yes. Some questions have recognized differences among the four schools and should be attributed to their source.

conversion.title: How to become Muslim
conversion.intro: Becoming Muslim involves affirming the two testimonies of faith with conviction and intention, understanding their meaning, and beginning to learn what is required.
conversion.note: The site does not turn becoming Muslim into an online test.
